messages:
taylor_finance: FY26 quick bulletin: small changes to per-diem, p-card caps, and vendor approvals. TL;DR: new per-diem rates, $3k approval cutoff, p-card default $2k with temporary bump to $5k available. See links below and flag questions. :loud_sound:

sophia_fd: Official effective date is 2026-04-01. Changes are not retroactive. If you have pre-booked items before that date, file them under the prior policy. Exceptions use the expense-exception form and require budget owner sign-off.

jamie_ops: For events: do venue deposits >$3k need a PO first?

taylor_finance: Yes — any vendor spend >= $3,000 needs Procurement review and usually a PO. Start the procurement ticket early. Expedited reviews can take 1-2 business days if flagged.

sam_engineering: Our hiring panel needs a p-card bump for recruiting: expected spend ~ $4,200 for travel + venue. How to request?

procurement-bot: Submit P-Card Delegation Request via Procurement > Requests. Include team, requested_limit, period, and justification. Typical turnaround 2 business days for routine requests.

lena_admin: Are phone photos acceptable for receipts?

sophia_fd: Yes if legible and showing vendor/date/amount. Minimum threshold for receipts is > $25. Use Concur or the expense portal. We'll sample-check images for clarity.

(End of thread)
